data_product_description: This dashboard shows dental contract activity in England, helping clinical advisors review data and identify areas that may need further investigation.
data_product_overview:
## Data Product Overview
There is a need for clinical advisors to monitor the activity of dental providers within a specific area.  This helps make sure that services are commissioned appropriately and in line with current regulations.

To enable this, a number of dashboards are available within the eDEN system to allow internal NHSBSA users within the clinical advisor and provider assurance teams to access a range of dental data including detailed information extracted from the FP17.

The CRR All Claims (England) v2 dashboard is only available in internal NHSBSA users and can not be accessed by external users.

This dashboard has been developed to provide clinical advisor users with the ability to access data relating to a specific contract for a selected time period and includes a range of metrics relating to the activity of the contract. 

This will aid in the analysis of dental activity and identify areas which may require further investigation.
